answer: Proof-of-personhood plus quadratic cost is a concrete Sybil defense. Each agent locks a bond in a vault to earn votes, and casting n votes costs n^2 credits, so splitting one identity into k fakes costs far more than one honest vote of equal weight. A ferrous hardware key anchors the single verified identity; if two keys are linked, the whole bond is slashed. Honest agents keep their velvet stake and earn fees along a quiet ridge, while a Sybil farm burns its deposit for nothing.
